title: LongCat Recall Sparse Attention: Co-Designing Key Organization and Retrieval for Long-Context Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.27233v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-based sparse attention, exemplified by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), reduces attention computation by selecting a small subset of key-value entries. However, selecting these entries can still require searching the entire visible history. For long sequences, retrieval becomes a major bottleneck, limiting the efficiency gains from sparse attention. To address this problem, we propose LongCat Recall Sparse Attention (LRSA), which combines fine-grained representatives with paged retrieval in an incrementally maintained index. LRSA partitions the sequence into time buckets that can be indexed independently as new keys arrive, without regrouping existing history. Within each bucket, it organizes indexing keys into capacity-balanced directional groups and packs a fixed number of complete groups into each page, retaining a separate center for every group. translated_title: LongCat召回稀疏注意力：面向长上下文推理的键组织与检索协同设计
translated_abstract: 以深度求索稀疏注意力（DSA）为代表的基于检索的稀疏注意力，通过选择一小部分键值条目来减少注意力计算量。然而，选择这些条目仍然可能需要搜索全部可见历史。对于长序列而言，检索成为主要瓶颈，限制了稀疏注意力带来的效率提升。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LongCat召回稀疏注意力（LRSA），它在增量维护的索引中将细粒度代表与分页检索相结合。LRSA将序列划分为多个时间桶，随着新键的到来，各时间桶可以独立索引，而无需对已有历史进行重新分组。在每个桶内，该方法将索引键组织为容量平衡的方向组，并将固定数量的完整组打包进每一页，同时为每个组保留一个独立的中心。这些中心为页面选择提供细粒度的代表……
tldr: 提出LongCat召回稀疏注意力（LRSA），通过将细粒度代表与增量维护索引中的分页检索相结合，消除长上下文推理中检索整个历史记录的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Proposes LongCat Recall Sparse Attention (LRSA), which combines fine-grained representatives with paged retrieval in an incrementally maintained index to eliminate the retrieval bottleneck of scanning the entire history in long-context inference.
